asset.name: SegmentedControl
asset.description: The compact mutually exclusive selector with a shared moving indicator, keyboard navigation, responsive overflow, and icon or text options.

requires.reason: Sizing, spacing, and radius resolve to declared ramps rather than literals.
Variant styling is declared as an enumerable recipe so the implementation is checkable against the catalog.
Composite widgets expose a single tab stop with arrow-key movement.
Controlled and uncontrolled operation share one contract and one event shape.
The moving indicator animates as a shared layout element rather than by tweening position.
